payload.summary: Debounce Levenshtein typo calculations in universal search command palette
payload.detail: In src/components/clinical-dashboard/universal-search-command-surface.tsx, rankLocalFavourites computes typo distances (Levenshtein distance) synchronously across favourite items on every keystroke. Adding a 30-50 ms micro-debounce when typing rapidly prevents main-thread stuttering during fast input sequences while keeping arrow-key selection immediate.
